title: The overview's guide line names four of the six guides, and configuration.md's release step 6 says only the macOS stage's artefact gets a seal cache line
body:
Two small gaps between the docs and the code, found while writing docs/assembly-and-the-build-cache.md (ST0011/18). Record only, for the next release.

1. The overview's guide line leaves out two guides. `show_guides` in lib/cmd/devbin prints "The long-form guides (authoring-commands, configuration, migration, releasing)". It names neither docs/assembly-and-the-build-cache.md nor docs/dev-opt-brew.md, though the README's documentation table links both and the formula installs docs/ whole. The arms that read the line (`assert_guides_at` in tests/lib/test_helper.bash, from dispatch.bats, machinepointer.bats and releasecore.bats) check only that each listed guide exists, so nothing goes red. The fix: list every guide a user reads, or derive the list from docs/ itself.

2. docs/configuration.md, the release section's step 6 (Legs, line 419), ends: "Once every leg is green, the macOS stage's artefact, where it has one, gets one `cache<TAB><artefact><TAB><key>` line". `legs_cache_lines` in lib/cmd/release writes that line for every artefact the build: block declares, the macOS stage's app among them (issue 0338). The sentence should say every artefact, as the new guide and the code do.
